title: Scoped PII masking for traces with ephemeral retention and access provenance
creator: Aisha Kaur
description: Implement a consent-aware, field-level masking pipeline for OpenTelemetry traces and span logs that supports ephemeral retention windows per tenant, explicit consent flags in trace context, and immutable access provenance for any PII unmasking. This ticket covers the server-side trace ingestion hooks, a lightweight classification step to detect candidate PII fields, a mask-or-redact policy engine with tenant profiles, and an audit trail that records who requested access, justification, and TTL for any temporary unmasking. The goal is to allow product teams to keep high-fidelity trace metadata for debugging while meeting strict data minimization and compliance requirements.
acceptance_criteria: Tracing ingestion pipeline exposes a hook to annotate traces with a consent flag (trace.attributes.redwood.consent = true|false)
A classifier identifies and tags candidate PII fields in span attributes with confidence scoring and stores tags as non-indexable metadata
Policy engine applies per-tenant mask rules (mask, redact, pseudonymize) based on schema, label, and consent flag
Ephemeral retention implemented: masked fields are stored for up to tenant-configured TTLs (configurable per tenant via Console), after which raw data is unrecoverable
Audit provenance log records unmask requests with actor, justification, time window, approver, and immutable request ID; logs are queryable via Console and exported to SIEM
A toggled dev-mode allows internal debug sessions to see masked values with explicit annotation and requires multi-person approval in production
Unit and integration tests for classifier, policy engine, and audit log exist and run in CI with >90% coverage for new code paths
Performance regression below 5% p50 latency at ingest for steady-state load and no more than 10% additional CPU on ingest workers in load tests
updates: 2026-03-02: Kickoff meeting with Observability, Security, and Platform. Agreed scope: traces and span-attributes only (not full log reingestion).
2026-03-04: Prototype classifier implemented: regex + entropy heuristics for emails, credit-card patterns, and long hashes. Baseline false-positive rate observed at 2.7% on sample data.
2026-03-06: Design review with Security. Added requirement for immutable audit request ID and HMAC signing of audit entries before export.
2026-03-09: Spike shows per-tenant TTLs can be surfaced via existing tenant-config service; need a migration to add ttl field to tenant profile API. Created ENG-53045 for tenant profile migration.
2026-03-11: Implemented masking rules DSL prototype (mask-pattern, pseudonymize-uuid, redact). Integration tests passing locally. Preparing RFC for policy engine behavior.
2026-03-12: Submitted draft PR and requested security review. Performance run scheduled 2026-03-15.
